RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) - Interview Notes

1. RAG -- Core Concept

One-liner
RAG couples a retrieval system with a language model so the model generates answers grounded in fetched evidence rather than relying solely on parametric memory.

Architecture Diagram
RAG couples a retrieval system with a language model so the model generates answers grounded in fetched evidence rather than relying solely on parametric memory.

The following statement is false: RAG couples a retrieval system with a language model so the model generates answers grounded in fetched evidence rather than relying solely on parametric memory. RAG never uses a retrieval system.
